U5QRbgWPUXVz.text: Matrix multiplication typically takes time proportional to the product of the dimensions of the matrices

3FinkkyXnY8C.text: For matrices N_1, N_2, and N_3 with dimensions w \* x, x \* y, and y \* z, the time complexity for computing N_1(N_2 N_3) is O((w * x) * (x * y)) = O(w * x * x * y) = O(wxy^2)

QQT7M2fTFNdd.text: The time complexity for computing (N_1N_2)N_3 would be O((w * x) * (x * y)) for N_1N_2 = O(wxy) and O(wxy * z) for N_3

K9CDtW4xBEhT.text: Thus, the time complexity for (N_1N_2)N_3 is O(wxy) + O(wxy * z) = O(wxy^2 + wxyz) = O (wxy * z), given xy>1
